replaces.idea: A standing dark-iron rotary card index (rolodex) with numbered tabs that flips to the matching interrupt handler.
A twin-track railway switch lever that diverts readers onto a fresh rail while the old rail is retired.

new.name: Vector Rolodex
new.depicts: A standing dark-iron rotary card index on two splayed feet, with a side knob and fanned cream index cards.
new.focal: One bright yellow-tabbed index card flipped upright at the top.

new.name: Grace-Period Switch
new.depicts: A heavy iron twin-track railway switch lever mounted on a riveted baseplate, with a coral-red handle and two diverging short rails.
new.focal: The bright yellow pivot pin locking the switch blade onto the fresh rail.

new.name: Memory Barrier
new.depicts: A weighted iron-post crossing gate with a striped coral-red and yellow barrier arm resting across a forked catch-post.
new.focal: The glowing yellow warning lantern mounted atop the hinge post.

new.name: Core Telegraph
new.depicts: A compact brass-and-iron telegraph tapper key mounted on a dark rectangular plinth with two binding posts.
new.focal: The bright yellow contact spark between the anvil and the depressed key.

new.name: Swap Interlock
new.depicts: A small spring-loaded dual-keyed brass padlock body resting on a flat iron baseplate with two keyholes side by side.
new.focal: One bright yellow key inserted and turned in the right keyhole.

new.name: Ring Turnstile
new.depicts: A waist-high iron tripod turnstile bolted to a floor plate, with three angled barrier arms.
new.focal: The bright yellow mechanical ratchet gear at the hub.

rework.redesign: Redraw as a standing brass-and-iron mechanical relay switchboard on heavy legs, with physical clapper switches, busbar rods, and a top row of hooded status lamps.
Redraw as a 6x6+ px armored interrupt spark-mite with a 1 px darkest-ink outline, two 1x1 px dark eyes, and two stubby yellow side fins.
